verdict.rationale: Composio stores and refreshes each end user's connected accounts (Gmail, GitHub, Slack) against that user's userID. Sessions are created per user_id, and toolkit or auth-config restrictions narrow what each session can reach. The core story of a user's agent acting on that user's own credentials is clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-user scoped tokens or credential-isolation guarantees, details on per-user account management and revocation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
